rules: Current eligible tax first; prior balances use remaining same-country cap
Prior balances allocated oldest eligible first, explicit allocation_order in output
Original years retained; no reset of five-year expiry
Expired before2026, expires at end2026, and next-year carryforward separately reported
Prior-only countries preserve unused eligible balances
Duplicate/current/future origin years and unverified history rejected
remaining: Saved income and annual category tax reconciliation
delivery: Local only; no cloud upload, remote push or main merge.
